description: This file defines types, constants, and functions for parsing and manipulating inline directives within message texts, such as audio tags and reply tags, including functions for stripping and normalizing these directives.

methods.name: replacementPreservesWordBoundary
methods.description: Replaces matched directive with a space if it is between non-whitespace characters to preserve word boundaries.

methods.name: normalizeDirectiveWhitespace
methods.description: Normalizes whitespace in directive text, replacing line endings, reducing multiple spaces, and trimming.

methods.name: stripInlineDirectiveTagsForDisplay
methods.description: Removes audio and reply inline tags from text for display purposes.

methods.name: stripInlineDirectiveTagsForDelivery
methods.description: Removes inline directive tags with padding from text for delivery purposes.

methods.name: isMessageTextPart
methods.description: Type guard to check if a message part is a text part.

methods.name: stripInlineDirectiveTagsFromMessageForDisplay
methods.description: Removes inline directive tags from message content while preserving message shape.

methods.name: parseInlineDirectives
methods.description: Parses inline directives in text, identifying audio and reply tags, and returns cleaned text with metadata.
